author: TotallyBeast
body:
Hello! I am TotallyBeast, and I love to build. I have lots of experience with World Edit and terrain building. I can build pretty much anything anyone asks me to make. Here are so pictures to prove that I can build!


This is a cliff build with an overhang, and a sun-shape cutout into the building: https://gyazo.com/8d842dbe2d7837f480e273114517e1f1

Here is a tower that I created with leaves dripping down the outskirts:

https://gyazo.com/717222fc00a1447b31b11b23a7624182

Here is a rainbow tower that I created on a terrain block:

https://gyazo.com/23f6db334a20f48bd82e00e62dda847a

And if you need more pictures add me on discord. (TotallyBeast  #4510)

Thanks so much

-TotallyBeast

title: TotallyBeast Builder Application

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
Hello,

Your builds do look very good. However, we would like you to get more familiar with creating specific Avicus gamemode maps, such as a CTW or DTC/DTM. If you make maps, please post them with pictures in the appropriate subforum, for appropriate feedback.

This application is denied; have a nice day.
